newEvidence.title: UltraShot Injection System — Hot Runner Service Manual v1.1
newEvidence.scope: Requires qualified personnel and lockout/tagout of electrical, pneumatic and hydraulic energy sources before servicing or entering the mould area; system-specific and does not replace site isolation procedure.

newEvidence.title: From Manual to Automated: Exploring the Evolution of Switchover Methods in Injection Molding Processes—A Review
newEvidence.scope: Review of filling-to-holding switchover methods; supports early/late switchover consequences and sensitivity to material, machine and environmental conditions without defining a universal transfer point.

newEvidence.title: Moldflow Insight — Modeling for accurate clamp force prediction
newEvidence.scope: Defines clamp-force calculation as integration of pressure over projected area, supporting the physical opening-load relationship without authorizing a generic machine-sizing safety factor.

newEvidence.title: IntElect — activeProtect mould protection
newEvidence.scope: Describes activeProtect monitoring of clamp-force transmission during mould closing using force-signature sensing; specific to applicable Sumitomo IntElect equipment.

resolutions.reason: The manufacturer service manual explicitly requires hazardous-energy lockout/tagout before service or mould-area entry. This supports the warning that a controller stop is not proof of isolation, while exact isolation remains machine- and site-specific.

A peer-reviewed review directly describes early switchover as capable of incomplete filling and late switchover as capable of high pressure peaks, increased clamp demand and flash. ENGEL independently treats switchover as a process condition requiring adaptive control. The Book wording remains non-diagnostic and non-numeric.

Authoritative engineering documentation calculates opening force from pressure acting over projected area, and machine-manufacturer process guidance independently treats clamping force as a measured mould/process quantity. No generic sizing factor is introduced.

Sumitomo documents a specific mould-protection implementation based on clamp-force-signature monitoring during closing, demonstrating that mould protection is a controller/machine function. ISO machinery-safety scope remains separate, so mould protection is not presented as a substitute for guarding or maintenance.

effectiveHighRiskDisposition.note: Removing claim-level blockers does not verify any chapter. Complete claim inventory, technical review, source-currentness recheck and publication sign-off remain mandatory.
